title: #362 High Salary
prompt: Some famous entertainers earn millions of dollars every year. Few people think they deserve such high salaries. What is your opinion?

promptSegments.text: Some famous entertainers earn millions of dollars every year.
Few people think they deserve such high salaries.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The salary of famous entertainers is justified because their work provides fun and entertainment to many people.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The money of entertainers is necessary because the cost of living in big cities is very high.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The payments of famous people are high because their work is popular and requires skill.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The high payments are justified because the performers are talented and put in a lot of work.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The high payments are justified because the performers are talented and put in a lot of work.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary reason for high salaries is the skill and effort entertainers put into their performances, which provides enjoyment to the public.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary reason for high salaries is the skill and effort entertainers put into their performances, which provides enjoyment to the public.

angles.label: Point 2

angles.en: The high salary reflects the scale of professional success.

modelPlan.focus: Discuss whether famous entertainers deserve high salaries by examining their contributions, industry standards, and public perception.
keyArguments: Famous entertainers contribute significantly to culture and the economy, which justifies their high salaries.
While some may question their earnings, industry standards and market forces often determine their remuneration.
